title: ElizaTrade
tagline: ElizaTrade – An AI-powered Telegram trading bot that extracts signals, analyzes risk, and auto-executes trades on CEX & DEX. Powered by Eliza AI, it confirms orders, adjusts stop-losses, and syncs across exchanges for smarter trading!
description:
ElizaTrade is an AI-powered trading assistant that analyzes Telegram-based trade signals, interprets them using natural language processing (NLP) with Eliza AI, and automatically executes trades on centralized (CEX) and decentralized (DEX) exchanges.

Unlike traditional trading bots that blindly follow signals, ElizaTrade engages in real-time conversations, confirming trades, adjusting stop-losses, and helping users manage risk dynamically.

By integrating Telegram APIs, Eliza AI for NLP, CCXT for CEX trading, and Solana SDK for DEX trading, ElizaTrade provides a seamless and intelligent automated trading experience.
how_its_made: ElizaTrade is an AI-powered trading bot that automates trade execution from Telegram signals by leveraging Eliza AI, NLP, and blockchain automation. It scans messages in trading groups using advanced text parsing and machine learning to extract structured trade signals, including entry price, stop-loss, and take-profit levels. The bot then validates signals, ensures optimal execution conditions, and places trades on both centralized exchanges (CEXs) like Binance, KuCoin, and OKX using CCXT, as well as decentralized exchanges (DEXs) like Uniswap and Jupiter via Solana SDK and Ethers.js. ElizaTrade includes real-time monitoring, adaptive stop-loss adjustments, AI-driven risk management, and automated hedging strategies to maximize profits while minimizing risks. It features a conversational interface that confirms trades when market conditions change and provides instant Telegram notifications on trade execution and portfolio performance. The bot also incorporates MEV protection, rate-limiting, and proxy rotation to prevent front-running and API bans. Future upgrades include AI-powered sentiment analysis, on-chain trade verification, arbitrage trading, and strategy backtesting. By combining NLP, AI-driven trade optimization, and seamless Web3 integration, ElizaTrade offers an innovative, intelligent, and efficient way to automate crypto trading without losing control over risk management. 🚀
